entries.name: Keep & defend the harbor (Rao aid-station, Newark DE)
entries.note: ~2 dozen survivors, two surgeons + Shake, in a famine ~20-25 mi from a Warlord. Sustain/feed/protect it; decide its future. *(opened Day +5)*

entries.name: The Shepherd (campaign boss — Warlord mind-Dominator, ~20-25 mi NE)
entries.note: Holds a captured refuge (~upper Chester Co PA), a dominated "flock", ~8-mi mental reach; now aware powered strangers are in its county. Above Shake's tier — flee/out-think. A master of Akhil's power-category. *(opened Day +2)*

entries.name: The Crossing, hostile & hunting (Vance / Boyd)
entries.note: Sgt. Vance's first-responder column (redirected N to the Poconos); Boyd vindicated/rising; they know the brothers' faces & natures and want them. *(opened Day +2)*

entries.name: Akhil's recovery & his dangerous mind-power
entries.note: Heal him; learn whether/how he can ever safely use the Breaker mind-power that nearly killed and nearly un-made him. *(opened Day +4)*

entries.name: A family of the changed (Shake/Akhil/Bhaskar; a secret to keep)
entries.note: Shake (kinetic), Akhil (mind), Bhaskar/Dad (phasing) manifested; only Sudha/Mom unchanged. Three hunted people in a lynching world. *(opened Day +5)*

entries.name: What am I now? (kinetic ceilings; the Rush)
entries.note: Kinetic control mostly mapped; still unknown: true ceilings, what fully feeding the Rush does. *(ongoing)*

entries.name: Mateo, left behind (held by Dylan)
entries.note: The ~6yo Shake pulled off his transformed father, then abandoned at Dylan's NJ school; held by bitter Dylan. Guilt/Legacy. *(opened Day 0)*

entries.name: The Changed of the grove (Mateo's father, alive & hunting)
entries.note: Heavy transformed predator, defeated & spared, alive & hunting, his son taken. May recur. *(opened Day 0)*

entries.name: Mobs hunt the powered (the world's default)
entries.note: Frightened survivors lynch the visibly changed. Sharpens every exposure. *(opened Day 0)*

entries.name: Bergen County family (N. NJ — fate unknown)
